BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION)

CLASS: IMSC   SEMESTER: III
BRANCH: FOOD TECH.  SESSION : MO/2018

SUBJECT : IMF3001 FOOD COMPOSITION & CHEM.

TIME: 1.5  HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The total marks of the questions are 30.
2. Candidates may attempt for all 30 marks.
3. In those cases where the marks obtained exceed 25 marks, the excess will be ignored.
4. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
5. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Q1 (a) What is proximate composition of food? [2]
 (b) Describe the different types of water? [3]


Q2 (a) What do you mean by sorption behaviour? [2]
 (b) Describe the main constituent of food in brief. [3]


Q3 (a) Write down the properties of lipids.  [2]
 (b) How are lipids digested? [3]


Q4 (a) Write the name of two common fatty acids along with their chemical formula. [2]
 (b) What do you mean by hydrophilic protein? [3]


Q5 (a) What do you mean by carbohydrate?  [2]
 (b) Write down the derivatives of monosaccharides? [3]


Q6 (a) What are homopolysaccharides and heteropolysaccharides?  [2]
 (b) Classify the dietary carbohydrates and also give their example. [3]
